associates.clause: Persons closely associated with PDMRs are subject to additional dealing restrictions.
associates.reasoning: The policy defines Persons Closely Associated with PDMRs to include family members and companies, trusts or entities controlled by a PDMR, and subjects them to the same clearance and closed-period restrictions as PDMRs, which is where a hedge or loan is typically structured.

tiers.tier_name: All BHP directors, employees and contractors

findings.question: cash_hedge
findings.clause: This policy applies to all BHP directors, employees and contractors.
findings.reasoning: Only PDMRs, Restricted Persons and those on insider lists face a clearance regime, and the only hedging-specific rule binds incentive-plan participants solely for unvested or still-locked securities, so a cash-settled hedge over fully vested shares is unaddressed for ordinary directors, employees and contractors.

findings.question: physical_hedge
findings.clause: This policy applies to all BHP directors, employees and contractors.
findings.reasoning: The same absence of any clearance or hedging rule applies whatever the settlement method; the incentive-plan hedging restriction reaches only unvested or locked securities, leaving a physically settled hedge over fully vested shares unaddressed for the general population.

findings.question: encumber
findings.clause: This policy applies to all BHP directors, employees and contractors.
findings.reasoning: No clearance regime or encumbrance rule reaches directors, employees or contractors outside the insider-list, Restricted Person and PDMR categories, so pledging vested shares is unaddressed for the general population.

findings.question: borrow_against_stock
findings.clause: This policy applies to all BHP directors, employees and contractors.
findings.reasoning: Margin lending is only caught via the dealing definition where a clearance regime binds the tier; ordinary directors, employees and contractors are not subject to any clearance regime, so a margin loan secured on vested shares is unaddressed for them.

findings.question: borrow_against_derivative
findings.clause: This policy applies to all BHP directors, employees and contractors.
findings.reasoning: No provision addresses financing secured on a derivative rather than the shares themselves, and ordinary directors, employees and contractors have no clearance regime in any event, so this is unaddressed.

findings.question: stock_loan
findings.clause: This policy applies to all BHP directors, employees and contractors.
findings.reasoning: Stock lending agreements form part of the dealing definition, but that only matters where a clearance regime binds the tier; ordinary directors, employees and contractors face no such regime, so lending vested shares is unaddressed for them.

findings.question: lender_enforcement
findings.clause: This policy applies to all BHP directors, employees and contractors.
findings.reasoning: The exceptional-circumstances clearance route and the general clearance regime apply only to persons on insider lists, Restricted Persons and PDMRs; ordinary directors, employees and contractors have no clearance regime, so a lender's enforcement sale is unaddressed for them.

findings.question: cash_hedge
findings.clause: must request clearance before dealing in BHP securities from the Group Company Secretary by submitting a Securities Dealing Clearance Request Form.
findings.definition: entry into a contract to secure a profit or avoid a loss by reference to price fluctuations
findings.reasoning: PDMRs must obtain clearance before any dealing, and the dealing definition sweeps in a contract to secure a profit or avoid a loss by price fluctuations, which covers a cash-settled hedge; the separate ban on derivative dealing is confined to transactions on an exchange or other organised market, so an OTC bank collar or put falls to the general clearance requirement rather than an outright ban.

findings.question: physical_hedge
findings.clause: must request clearance before dealing in BHP securities from the Group Company Secretary by submitting a Securities Dealing Clearance Request Form.
findings.definition: the grant, acceptance, acquisition, disposal, exercise or discharge of any option
findings.reasoning: A physically settled collar or put is exercised as an option and ends in a disposal of shares, both squarely within the dealing definition, so a PDMR needs clearance before entering it; the exchange/organised-market derivative ban does not reach an OTC bank product.

findings.question: encumber
findings.clause: must request clearance before dealing in BHP securities from the Group Company Secretary by submitting a Securities Dealing Clearance Request Form.
findings.definition: use as security, or otherwise granting a charge, lien or other encumbrance over securities
findings.reasoning: Granting a charge, lien or other encumbrance over securities is expressly part of the dealing definition, so a PDMR must obtain clearance before pledging vested shares; the unvested-collateral ban in the additional PDMR restrictions does not reach vested shares.

findings.question: borrow_against_stock
findings.clause: must request clearance before dealing in BHP securities from the Group Company Secretary by submitting a Securities Dealing Clearance Request Form.
findings.definition: entry into any margin lending or other secured financing arrangement.
findings.reasoning: Margin lending is expressly named within the dealing definition, so a PDMR must obtain clearance before entering a margin loan secured on vested shares; the unvested-collateral ban does not reach vested shares.

findings.question: borrow_against_derivative
findings.clause: Dealing includes any transaction or change affecting title to or interest in securities, including:
findings.reasoning: The dealing definition and clearance regime turn on transactions affecting title to or interest in securities; a loan secured on a derivative rather than the shares themselves is not addressed, and there is no wording about financing in respect of securities generally, so this is unaddressed even for PDMRs.

findings.question: stock_loan
findings.clause: must request clearance before dealing in BHP securities from the Group Company Secretary by submitting a Securities Dealing Clearance Request Form.
findings.definition: entry into, termination of, assignment of, or novation of any stock lending agreement
findings.reasoning: Entry into a stock lending agreement is expressly part of the dealing definition, so a PDMR must obtain clearance before lending vested shares; this is distinct from the express short-selling ban, which addresses borrowing shares to sell short rather than lending them out.

findings.question: lender_enforcement
findings.clause: exceptional circumstances, such as severe financial difficulty or compulsion by court order, exist which require the immediate sale of shares
findings.reasoning: Section 6 allows clearance to deal during a closed period where exceptional circumstances such as severe financial difficulty require an immediate sale of shares, which covers a lender's forced sale on default; determination is reserved to the Group Company Secretary or Board Chair, and outside closed periods the general PDMR clearance requirement applies to any disposal.
